prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent game mouse cursor, standalone cutout, square canvas.
Primary request: An original old-fashioned Prussian heraldic war-hand sigil reimagined for the melancholy painterly bureaucratic world of Disco Elysium and Germany Simulator. A single antique ivory-white gloved right hand / heraldic manicule, dorsal three-quarter view, index finger pointing diagonally toward the upper-left, other fingers naturally curled. A short severe Prussian-blue officer's cuff, chipped black enamel trim, tarnished brass piping and one small embossed Prussian eagle seal at the wrist. The gesture reads immediately as a pointing interaction cursor.
Style/medium: hand-painted expressionist oil/gouache game illustration; coarse purposeful brush planes, weathered ivory, soot, oxidized brass, muted petrol teal and restrained rust-red accents. Angular melancholy political-surrealist mood. Distinct strong silhouette and a dark ink edge with a thin ivory rim to remain legible over dark and pale backgrounds.
Composition: exactly ONE hand, filling most of the square canvas with modest clear padding; fingertip is the highest and leftmost point near the upper-left corner, cuff trails to the lower-right. Compact hand-and-wrist only. Deliberately simple broad planes that survive reduction to a 48-pixel cursor. No thin dangling filigree, no detached ornament, no circle or plaque behind it.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, completely empty outside the hand, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground, no scene.
Constraints: no words, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no multiple views, no cursor arrow symbol, no UI mockup. Clean continuous silhouette.
